problems_and_corrections.notes: Replay safety, deadline and shared budget are exposed in the eligibility sieve. Primary and eligible secondary converge to one result; uncertain actions branch to reconciliation and an ineligible route stops. Gradual failback is a policy brace rather than a result path. Two rejected candidates had an incorrect failback connector and control bypass; the third corrected them. All fourteen labels are readable in the exact saved PNG.

Exploded chat base, decision and guardian adapters share the exposed KV cache; the speech encoder supplies transcription separately. Cyan decision output originates at decision adapter, purple safety output at guardian. First draft misattached decision output; corrected second draft also removed simulated writing. All fourteen labels are correct and legible. Geometry is conceptual model composition, not physical GPU architecture.

The five terraced stages preserve source/owner provenance; validation includes trust comparison and expert revalidation, organization separates scope and governance exposes permissions/audit. First draft had prohibited avatar symbols, omitted Deliver and duplicate Provenance. The corrected version removes avatars, includes all fourteen unique labels and retains the revalidation loop. Small document glyphs denote records rather than readable prose.

Fanned report leaves expose scope, access, disclosure terms, redactions, informal pressures and conflicts alongside methods and uncertainty. Confidential material is withheld from public scrutiny; findings are explicitly not certification. First draft added unauthorized headings and paragraph-like marks. Corrected second draft removes them and replaces a probability-like plot with unscaled conceptual uncertainty paths. All thirteen labels are readable.

Radial active context receives previews, recoverable summaries, selectively loaded skills and isolated-work results; raw evidence remains retrievable and plain-file long-term memory supports model portability. First draft included paragraph-like strokes and overly textured surfaces; second draft removes all faux writing and preserves fourteen labels. The five mechanisms are distinct and no raw subagent stream directly enters active context.

Permission lattice separates Allow/Ask/Deny skill loading from a read-only evidence-comparison bench and a separate human publishing decision. The draft and PR specimens use conventional list/branch glyphs without pseudo-letters or invented text. First draft contained a hand icon and crossed the publication wall; corrected second draft removes both and keeps outputs before the closed boundary. All fifteen labels readable and correct.

transport_note: One oversized base64 tool output was truncated by transport. Its orphan blob was rejected by exact local Git-blob identity and was never committed. Full PNGs were then transferred through bounded 192-KiB byte reads and independent exact-commit raw downloads. No accepted image was regenerated for transport.
improvement_proposals: Separate provider traffic, result convergence and failback policy geometry in the initial prompt.
State adapter-specific output origins explicitly before generation.
Represent human decisions only through abstract permission gates, never avatar or hand icons.
Use simple geometric record glyphs and forbid paragraph strokes in the first prompt.
Do not infer scheduled-task launch from an enabled schedule; persist a real start receipt when the worker begins.
Use byte-count-checked bounded chunks from the outset, with local 256-KiB fixed-offset reassembly integrity checks.
